- push image -> canary
- smoke -> run smoke suite against canary
- monitor -> SLO dashboard watch
- rollback -> toggle feature-flag + rollback script

1) Build published and image digest verified -> @alex
2) Canary lane reserved (1%) -> @tj
3) Smoke test owner + runbook -> @maria
4) Rollback owner & rollback command verified -> @anya
5) Pager rotation alerted -> @release-coordinator

